text: I love Mauhaus. My daughter begged for a cat for over a year so I just took her to Mauhaus every couple of Sunday's to get her fix. The staff are nice and the food and drinks are delicious. And here's the thing, the staff are there to watch and protect the cats, not make sure your every whim is met. And they do a tremendous job at that. And yes, we did find the perfect cat

The vibe of this place is awesome. It's a pretty space, well decorated, and BYO which is a plus. 

Service was solid, our waiter was attentive and friendly. 

Unfortunately the biggest gripe I have is with the food- it was pretty much a parade of mediocre dishes. The eggplant appetizer special was pretty flavorless, as was the tuna crudo appetizer. My friend had the octopus and said the accompanying items (potatoes etc) weren't even cooked. For mains- the pinza was okay, nothing to rave about. My friend's pappardelle pesto was truly flavorless, and overall the food was really disappointing.

Came here early Saturday morning, delicious gravy potatoes and biscuit! 
My wife had eggs Benedict with home fries and it was delicious... my father in law had classic huevos rancheros. One of the best b fast spots I've ever had shame it's a 8 hour drive but next time I'm in Reno I'll be stopping by for sure.

The cocktails were tasty, especially the tangerine spritz. The green papaya salad was over dressed. The crispy duck salad was great. The egg noodle dish with napa cabbage needed a whole lot more vegetables in it -- it was mostly noodles, but it was seasoned perfectly!

This place is nice and quaint. I believe it's newly opened and so they were still trying to get their systems in place. The food was good - our favorite was the honeymoon roll. Service was slow yes but our server was kind and was doing his best considering they were short staffed and newly opened. I would definitely go again.

This place does not disappoint! We ordered through door dash and ordered; 2 chorizo pupusas, 2 chicken and cheese pupusas, 2 chorizo tacos, and 1 chicken taco. Everything was very authentic and delicious! The tacos were layered between two corn taco shells, meat, onions, and cilantro. The pupusas were oozing with cheese and meat and fried to perfection. I couldn't rave enough about this place, we'll definitely be back!

Wow! Ordered a piZza at 6:50...we were told 45 minutes to an hour..2 hours later..I called and asked where is our pizza..oh..our telephone people took the wrong phone number ( website did not function).they duid not ask to repeat the phone number to ensure they had it correct..then 25 minutes after my  2nd request .....still no pizza so I call again.and I was told I had an attitude by the phone person when I said...hey...where's my pizza..Finally we got delivered a cold pizza..dont bother...a waste of time..left out ingredients..the rest of the supreme ingredients were sparse at best.la frozen supermarket pizza would have been better...a bitter disappointment..the only ray was the kind Manager who came to deliver the pizza..he was very nice.

This is more a diner than a café really. Stopped here for dinner before driving back from Philly. A rare occasion in which the Yelp reviews mislead us. The service was mediocre, the food even more so. Chicken and waffles were blah. Meatloaf was tasty but with the sides the entire plate was way too heavy.

This spot is amazing 
The drinks bring a lot of ice so ask light ahead
The food very good
The season so perfect and honestly I would come back on a good Sunday for just drinks. 
Waitress is very nice and he has a irish accent so that's pretty cool. They served us quick took us in inside or outside seating that has seat also. Will be coming back again when visiting the aquarium 

The empty plates speak a lot I had the steak and rib eye !!!
Great food. Love the wide variety from soup to sandwiches n the appetizers. They're nicely accommodating staff too

Girls Weekend Getaway Success!  Amazing food, shopping, drinks, laughter & did I mention food!  We have the most amazing stay, great Murder Mystery Walking Tour, Great Rooms, Amazing Food & Drinks, great service.  Covid sucks but spending the weekend with my friends in Peddlers Village!!! Awesome!!!!

Winghouse has always been a favorite wing stop for me but the Clearwater location hosts the best servers and the best bartenders.Tia is an amazing and attentive bartender who is constantly moving and making sure everyone at her bar  is okay. Riley is equally as attentive in ensuring that people ate taken care of. Ivy is one of the most caring servers in keeping up with her tables and ensuring everyone is okay. I will always come back to this location, Christine manages it beautifully. I love it here.

Love the Greek sandwich and the cannoli. I've never been disappointed here and always have had friendly service! Been coming here for a long time. I wish it were closer to my work/house, but it's definitely worth the trip over there.
The after dark happy hour is a great. Many choices of food and $5 wine!  It was super busy and good environment. Definitely would go back. The tempura and steaks bites were really tasty!

We are in town for our wedding anniversary and we're looking for a good pizza and Yelp lead us to TuttoRosso and it did not disappoint! We drank a bottle of the Pinot Noir, had an appetizer of the garlic Parmesan wings, a meats pizza, and then ordered a piece of tiramisu to go! The service was excellent and the food was phenomenal! We wish we could find a place like this near home!

Food was bland and not full spent 73 dollars here and the food was bad I couldn't fathom how tasteless it was . On top of that the soup omg was like water veggies and noodles and white chicken that wow I haven't had such bad food in such a long time
Love this place. Always fresh and great service.  Fast in and out with no shortage of flavor. Great fast food option
One of the best places to eat and drink, food is delicious and the servings are like for 2 ppl, prices are right and you won't be disappointed!!

Outdoor tables only, rarely a problem in Santa Barbara.  Good quality coffee, and my breakfast, a version of eggs benedict, was quite good and a fair price.  Carnitas, avocado, and eggs on a good biscuit.  No complaints.
Food is good but it took forever to get my food and the people who ordered after me actually got their food first.

Great spot for a quick meal or drink. Fun with a group. 
We've done both here and will continue to support this establishment especially during Covid. We missed them when they closed initially but have been back several times since they reopened the outdoor dining space. 
It's cute and landscaped. Big screen tv to watch golf and any games that might be on. Consistently Friendly staff. 
Great food which has stayed delicious and reasonable. 
They're doing takeout too. 
Last meal here was July 31, 2020 Saturday night with another couple. Great service, Cold beers, Wings, Caesar salad, burgers. All cooked as requested. Enough to take home leftovers which held up well for Sunday lunch. 
Stop in if you're local or passing through.

First time visiting after being hounded by a friend. It's not a bad place to get some seafood.  Nothing that knocked my socks off, just ok. The servers and ladies at the cash register were very nice and helpful.  There was two tv's one on each side of the restaurant but, only one was working and it displayed a cup of coffee. ?? I was kinda confused ‍ but ok. I think if they played some music at a low tone, it would make for a better atmosphere overall.

The good thing about Chili's are the special they always have, the 3 for $10 is certainly worth it and now the 2 for $25 comes with dessert, pretty hard to beat for the money, especially in this area. The waiter we had tonight was very friendly and did a great job, I don't remember his name, but said he was brand new. The only issue I can see ever happening here is the parking lot, I once had a door ding eating here, the parking lot is a bit tight and cars are too close together, so if you drive anything expensive maybe park at the mall and walk over. Chili's have a lively bar and it was quite loud, we don't drink so I cant comment on the alcohol or the drink prices, but the food is always good here and I recommend stopping in if you are in the area.

What a Gem to have Kenji's 1/4 mile away from my shop. The vibe and customer service was outstanding. Food had that true Hawaiian influence and tasted amazing. Will be sending over all my customers that wait for there tint jobs. -Taylor NNWT!

This place hit the spot. I am obsessed with crawfish and the spice is important. I was kinda worried about this place since it's not really an ambience kinda place., but when u taste the food it does the disappoint. The price was perfect. Many local people are here that's how u know the food is good

Went here for an anniversary dinner on a weekday night. First, the service was unbelievable. Perhaps because there were such few tables but we were attended to in every corner and the food came out at a very quick pace. When I was unsure of what wine to order, the server allowed me to try my choice. Loved every dish that we ordered. Plentiful and seasoned mussels. My scallops were cooked to perfection. I tried the steak too and was pretty good! Would definitely recommend this restaurant!!

Worst experience in New Orleans. Went to Corner Oyster House last night. Fat Tuesday I expected busy not rude. Waiter "David from Georgia", was interested In flipping tables. Told his tables they could order Red beans and rice or gumbo, you were stupid if you ordered anything. Tables all around us were eating full meals that looked good. Rolled his eyes at me when I asked a question and gave us water nothing else. Before walking away. Just make sure you are not in his station.
Made a huge catering order last minute for a business meeting: Not only did they come through with timing and accuracy (so rare) but the food was DELICIOUS! All around great. Thank you!

Sauce on the side is always great! My favorite is the Meat me in St. Louie Calzone. The cheese inside is amazing, so creamy, melty, and flavorful. The sausage inside is amazing as well. I can never get myself to try anything else when I go here because I love the meat me in st louis so much! Definitely go here and try this place! An STL staple for sure. The service is always good as well. You order at the counter and then they bring you your food to your table. I'm usually not a fan of places that have this type of service, but they do a good job paying attention to their customers and getting food out quickly.

I always take family here when they come into town! It's a St. Louis classic. Splurge on a plate, and you'll have food for at LEAST another meal, and the mac and cheese is a must. This is more like a once-a-year place for me because it is always so delicious but very heavy!
Homerun for lunch call take a chicken and waffles in a cone Marcus the owner is the bomb he's got it going on

My wife and I are traveling through Boise, during the pandemic and wanted a take out meal, that didn't come in a bun with fries. Kopper Kitchen was great the vegetables were flavorful but not over cooked. Loaded baked potato...YES!. I had Chicken Fried Chicken and the meat was flavorful and the crust was yummy and crunchy. It was ready when I got there and the staff were friendly.  New restaurant, with an old time dinner feel.
It can be loud sometimes but it´s worth the money as burgers are DELICIOUS. My kids love the chicken strips, and I always order burgers with extra bacon.

Went to Culver's for dinner. The drive thru was slow. There was a hole in my ice cream cup and it leaked everywhere. The staff was friendly and the food was hot and tasted good. They accepted my coupon and the food stayed hot until it was served at home. The pretzel bites are a yummy limited time item for now, but hopefully they will keep them on the menu.

I came here with a group of friends and we were able to have a wonderful brunch despite it not being the weekend. The interior of the restaurant is airy and spacious, especially because it was fairly empty on a Monday morning. All of our servers here are extremely warm and friendly, adding to the comfortable, welcoming experience.

I ordered the Mushroom & Goat Cheese Omelette which was good, as I expected it to be, but not exceptional. What I did find really special was the potatoes. Instead of the usual home fries or hash, Winkel serves these crispy smashed potatoes that are deliciously caramelized and textured. Unable as always to choose between savory and sweet, my friends and I decided to split a stack of pancakes as well and we went for the Bacon & Blackberry Pancakes. These were absolutely divine! Some of the best pancakes I've ever had in my life. The bacon lent a great richness without being overpowering and you could taste the buttermilk in the fluffy batter. The pancakes were so delicious on their own that I didn't even reach for syrup.

I would highly recommend Winkel for breakfast any day of the week. Food and service were both fantastic!

Well I must say I miss the days of past when peter piper was the place to go for kids, and adults to chill while the kids have some fun. I remember it being so much better as far as the food, service, and games. All I can really say is that this location is pretty mediocre  compared the most. The game section is small, the employees are doing the bare minimum, and the food is just, "ok". I would recommend the location on Broadway to be honest.
I was here on Wednesday March 11 and Megan was our server. She was excellent!! Wings were great and the music (John Rodden) was great as well.
Great tasting crab legs every time! I love the Mr/Mrs Crab special sauce! ASK FOR SAM! She is amazing! She made sure we had everything! Awesome customer service!

I've been here several times for client lunches and happy hours after work or with friends. They have great happy hour sangria and their table side guac is a MUST! They make the guac right in front of you. Also, I definitely recommend sitting outside. Their covered patio seating area makes for such a great atmosphere complete with a fountain and Mexican decor. It's a great place to have a drink and relax!

If you want a fresh, farm to table breakfast then give First Watch a try.  I've seen a couple comments about a long wait, we've never waited longer than 15 minutes, even when it's crowded.  

The food here is the definition of fresh, it just has a different taste to it.  It's so good.  They have a great variety to choose from, rather that be something salty like biscuits and gravy to something sweet like fruit pancakes or French toast.  

The service is always good, the waitresses are friendly and always refill your coffee for you. 

This is a favorite spot of ours for a breakfast that fills you up and leaves you feeling great.
Very clean place.  Great food.  Actually met the owner, she very nice and inviting.  Had the steak hoagie with fries, fantastic food!!   Definitely recommend.

Excellent spot with plenty of selection. I've been here a couple of times and was very impressed. The food is great, prices are fair, and preparation is fast. I most recently ordered (and highly recommend!) the bean rice and cheese burrito with salsa.

Stop here frequently on my way to work in the morning. My fav combo is the Asiago cheese bagel with honey walnut cream cheese - great sweet and savory combination. This time I went with chive and onion cream cheese, which I enjoyed. Service can be a little slow at times.

The part about me getting spoiled /sour food (half off menu , beware) was not as bad as my coming back to the restaurant to state my concerns to the manager but to be completely ignored bc I ordered a discounted item.  Unbelievable.  Don't offer 1/2 off for spoiled food, just throw it away!

I'm honestly scratching my head, trying to figure out what to say about this place.  Clearly, it's a family favorite for kids' birthdays because the place was absolutely packed when we went in at 7 PM on Saturday night.  And therein might lie the problem... It's like this place has lost its sense of identity and purpose.  It doesn't know if it wants to be a Chuck E. Cheese type establishment or if it wants to be a pizza restaurant.  In the hour or so we were there, they celebrated six or seven kids' birthdays with loud sirens and whistles blowing.  It was all great fun, but the staff looks and acts so disheartened and low-energy, like they just don't care anymore.
When we first walked in, every single table in the over-crowded restaurant was taken.  Just as we were about to leave, a family informed us they were vacating their booth.  We looked around for someone to bus our table and saw a young man delivering drinks to another table.  I waved him over and he told us kind of rudely that he would get to it "in a minute," but then seemed to think better of it and went ahead and cleaned the table.
Apparently, they do not take your order at the table; you have to go up to the window and order, but there is no clear signage indicating this.  I went up to the window to place our order and the lady was very nice, but seemed to think I should know how things worked there (we are from another state and have never eaten here before).  I was left wondering if they assume everyone is a lo

I was quite impressed! The service was top notch! Kept our drinks full, the food was very good i got the red chille plate my husband got chilaquiles. So delicious!  The chips and salsa were delicious too! We will be back again soon

We came for dinner and dessert. The food was fine. We ordered a cheeseburger and coke, chili cheese dog, kids' chicken nuggets, and kids' grilled cheese. I would say everything sort of reminds me a more homey Sonics. Service was fine. I felt very defensive inside. The guy taking our order seemed to think we were cutting everyone in line when we arrived and waited at a safe distance away from the people ordering in front of us. I'm not sure how he couldn't see my family of four waiting. The place is not big. Another couple comes in after us and tries to skip us by going to the second register. I felt like the guy taking our order was accusing us of trying to skip them. It didn't help the other patrons who came in after us responded in a way to make it seem like they came before us too, even though we told them we were in line...
Anyways...the banana split was pretty basic and classic. Strawberry shortcake had a little too much strawberry compote. It was kind of drowning in it. It tasted fine. My kids got ice cream, which they enjoyed. 
I would return for my kids to get ice cream, but maybe I'll be more prepared and vocal that I'm next to order. I'm not sure how to be more visible in the tight space. There was no inside seating due to COVID.  You can sit outside at some of the outdoor bench tables.
Stopped in for a quick breakfast sambo.  The woman behind the grill was friendly and welcoming.  I ordered a hot beef sausage, egg, cheese with fried onions.  It was delicious.

I will start by saying I am a true Chipotle customer. I will find a restaurant anywhere I am. This location however, seriously needs new management or something. It's unbelievable how they lack professionalism, sense of urgency or anything for that matter especially now during this COVID time. 
     I frequent this location because it's near my job and home. It's gotten to the point where I'm willing to drive further to go to another Chipotle just because this one sucks. Examples of how they need new management...one, seems like they pick and choose when they let you order inside or online only. Two, the whole purpose of ordering online is to have it waiting for you upon arrival, NEVER is. Today, I was one of the MANY people anxiously waiting on employees who not only took their time but carried on with their personal conversations while the store was almost filled of people waiting. A line formed for people to order inside while an employee was setting that side up at 12:30pm. Mind you store opens at 10:45AM! Someone saw the line form and yelled with an attitude "ONLINE ONLY" while he was preparing food in the back. 
      Before I came I ordered my food online at 12:00p and got there at my promised time 12:30p. I waited in there until 12:50 for food. Not only did they make it super late but they didn't call out orders made or put them in the spot people are supposed to pick up so it sat and sat. Finally I walked over to check the bags along with about 10 other people hoveri

Used to by my favorite go to poke place in IV. Then they decided to change their already overpriced menu. Now it costs me at least $16 just to get about halfway full. I used to be willing to pay the money but now their "medium" is 3 sides and 2 proteins. Yup. 2 proteins. I just can't justify spending money at this place anymore even though it's good food. The pricing is just absurd.

My sister lives in Fishtown, and this is hands down our favorite brunch spot. The dozen or so times we stopped pre-COVID were all incredible -- the food, the atmosphere, the service have been consistently good every time. 

My go-to order is the huevos rancheros, but I also enjoy a good Front Street Benedict or, if it's later in the day, the chipotle turkey burger and buffalo cauliflower (definitely get garlic siracha if you like a little heat). I used to love their tarragon chicken salad, but I haven't seen it on the menu for some time. Guess I'll have to figure out how to make that one myself.

The staff has always been friendly and our servers have always been incredibly nice and helpful. The vibe is great, too, whether you're sitting inside or out on the huge outdoor patio. I like the tables out there a little more -- they're big and you get more space between tables.  

I haven't been able to stop in since the spring, so I am counting down the days to their 2021 re-opening.
Heard only good things about this place so I had to try it.  Their tomato pie was by far the best I've ever had.

Very delicious steak cooked medium it was juicy and very flavorful. I wasn't really feeling the bread but I did enjoy the fact when you get your drink you don't pay 10dollars for one drink they give you a cup with the rest of your margarita so you can refill yourself up to 3-4 times.

Not as spicy as Popeyes but good it does have a nice little kick.  Great to get and bring back to your hotel the Hampton Inn a block away.  My only complaint is for the price of white meat, you get 2 wings and a breast.  I would have expected 2 breasts.  Still a great place to go.
Nice place to visit when in Philly. There is a little bit of everything. Shout out to the businesses which are closed on Sunday's ! I suggest parking in the street lots for $10 all day.

This place was a COMPLETE joke. DO NOT COME HERE. The shot girl asked me and my 2 friends if we wanted a round and I asked what the price was going to be and she did not answer. She then proceeded to pour the shots into our mouths. On the price menu it says $5 per shot which we had 3 each... totals out to $45 which is completely fine. When the woman handed me the bill it was $72 DOLLARS!!!!! I have the receipt to prove it. I was awfully scammed - mind you we are from the New Orleans area and should've known better. I went up to her an asked why my bill was so high because the shots were only $5/piece. She then answer "baby we include the tip on the bill". I demanded a better answer and could not be given one. I was charged $72 and then she HARASSED ME FOR AN ADDITIONAL TIP. I will never be going back to this place EVER AGAIN. I learned my lesson and I just dont know what to think at this point. Please if you are ever lured in or asked to get drinks from this horrible business DO NOT DO IT. The owner needs a reality check into how bad these "bartenders " scam people of their money... SHUT THIS HORRIFIC PLACE DOWN.

I SO look forward to Shake Shack when I visit America! This was no exception to the best burgers I have had. The service was good, fast and friendly and the food was delicious. I ordered the original shack burger and the crinkly fries. Delicious. Im drooling just writing this review...

There was an employee there who was VERY nice and helpful. He even offered to get our drink refills for us! I didn't get his name but he was very friendly!

The customer service at this location is always great. The problem I always have is whenever I get a cookie or a brownie added to my meal, they forget it. It's been multiple times. It's pretty frustrating.

Probably one of my favorite places to go for a casual date night with my husband! The pretzel is amazing and easy to share with two people (yes you can eat one on your own, no judgements). It comes with mustard and cheese dipping sauces. The onion rings are delicious and pairs well with the chipotle aioli dipping sauce. My hubby and i split the black and blue burger and substituted chicken. Ah-mazing!! The chicken was tender and the flavors were incredible! Highly recommend it. The place appears small on the inside but there is plenty of outside in the front and back
They made a mistake but took care of the issue with compassion and rushed it. 1st rate crew!
Not my favorite restaurant/bar in St. Louis. Been there one or times - rude staff who smoke right outside the restaurant. Food is okay. Drinks are sweet and nothing to brag about.

Dude I miss the Lipstick Lounge so much right now. Brought some friends in to celebrate Pride last year and the community vibe was so welcoming & open. Karaoke was a blast & I really wish I had the chance to go more often; will try to stop by more when 2020 chills out a bit.

I saw this place out of the corner of my eye and the cactus reflected off my cornea in the most majestic way but I will attempt to. Try to explain to you today. The aroma was absolutely breath taking, to the point I would like that to be my last breath. Honestly, the lack of seeing our waitress pleased me and let me focus on what mattered most. The margaritas...the margaritas... made my taste buds dance. A dance that hasn't been danced since Leo Sayer made us all feel like dancing. And then the cinnamon sprinkles on the complimentary butter and rolls were a taste that hasn't been tasted since Jesus Christ broke bread with his disciples. Would highly recommend.

I feel like this might be one of those places where if you aren't looking for it, you'd pass it right by. It's in an unassuming location but don't let that stop you from visiting. Once you walk through the front doors, it's almost like going back in time to an old time theater. Due to COVID, I imagine the seating was spaced out more than normal, so it kind of gave it an empty feel, but you can't blame the restaurant for that. 

A friend recommended to check this place out for brunch, but because we're rebels, we decided to go for dinner. I'm very glad we did because the food was amazing! All three of us enjoyed our dinners and drinks. The lighting was just dimmed enough to be intimate, and there didn't seem to be a noise level was that bothersome, but it was pretty chilly in there! I had the Piccola-Boca pasta which was very delicious, one friend had the Blackened Swordfish that looked quite tasty and the other friend had the Pan Seared Scallops - by far the best dish of all three. The scallops were cooked perfectly and the flavors in that dish were drool-worthy. 

We had a great experience and next time will come back for brunch. Make sure you check out the bathrooms, they're pretty epic.

I love that this place is open til 11pm! I was able to come in here at 10pm and the workers were so nice. They did not rush us and they were very patient and attentive. We had this nice gentleman as our waiter and he was great. He always made sure we had everything we needed and checked up on us to see if we were doing okay. 

I ordered the Lemon Chicken Piccata which tasted delicious! My partner ordered the Salisbury Steak and she loved it. While we did come close to closing time, they were still accommodating and still had desert for us to order! I would definitely recommend this place! It's a great place to come to for celebrating and if you're looking for a nice restaurant. The place is lightly dimmed so it is set for romantic occasions!

The restaurant is very clean. The workers are very nice and helpful. The butter burger was well-seasoned, well-seared, and a good size. The value is good. So delicious. and the frozen custard is good, too.
This place is pretty cool and the menu is so diverse! I can't wait to be back. I bought a smoothie but their food looks really good too. I also got some banana bread for my mom and she loved it.
Always a great meal and priced well for the amount of food served.  Great staff!!!  Always quick to be seated, even if you have a short wait.  When the weather is good try the outdoor patio.

My friend and I ventured here for lunch. They have a 4/5 star on here so I thought "Why not!". Let's just say I don't know how this place has a 4 star to begin with. We show up and wait at the host stand, where no one was standing. We weren't sure to seat ourselves or to wait for someone to seat us. Then a server pasts us without saying anything to us. Not saying I expected him to seat us but a "someone will be with you in just a moment" would be nice. Finally we were seated outside, they have a cute patio area! We ordered queso which was some of the most disappointing queso I've ever had.... it was just a block of velveeta cheese melted into a bowl. We had to order a thing of salsa to mix in it to give it flavor. I ordered the chicken enchiladas and my friend ordered the wet burrito. Both were just disappointing. The rice was like it came from a package, and it was Mexican food I could've made myself at home. My friends burrito had a ton of shrimp in it, but same thing, the quality of the food was extremely disappointing. Also, we were sat by one server and then helped by about 5 different people. We weren't sure if they were runners or servers or who we could order what from? It was kind of confusing. One of the severs was so sweet! I wish I caught her name. She made our experience better for sure, and I feel bad not giving her credit for her work. Although, I won't be returning simply for the quality of the food.
Permanently closed and fixtures removed, though website is still up as of March 27, 2020.

I've been to the LD in Palm Harbor and now this one. Very nice selection of cakes upon entry. Food was delicious all our meals were on point. I had the Rueben sandwich. It wasn't dry or excessively soggy from the kraut and dressing. I did give it four stars because the service was lacking. We had to grab our server twice for refills. They passed by so fast and never bothered to check on us. Really need to work on that. Other than that food was great. No they weren't being trained and weren't busy with maybe 4 tables in the restaurant with people.

I ordered a pasta dish that had sausage in it. At the time, I didn't know the sausage couldn't be removed. I returned the item and currently still waiting on my refund. The two drinks I ordered were very good tho.

Great food, drinks, and atmosphere. We ate there at sunset almost every night! Shrimp is amazing and you can't beat the mahi mahi! I am not a professional photographer, the view is really just that amazing!
I love Cracker Barrel . This one was very clean and a shout out to Sherry, my server. She was prompt and didn't make a big deal over me asking for a lunch before 10:30.

Came here while visiting St Louis. Homerun for any pizza lover. Never really had a real Calzone but they were amazing!!!! I made my own and my kids chose 2 different ones, they were ALL great. Cool vibe and employees were very willing and cheerful when answering all our questions. It was so good we visited a second time in a 4 day stay. (Different location, same experience) Parking at this location was on the street but easy during a business day.

This is my favorite restaurant! It is so delicious. ALWAYS GET THE QUESO!!! 
It is amazing. The people are very nice. Great food too. Tito's is the best Mexican food ever.
Had a really great California cheesesteak from Sal's last night. Great local Italian pizza sub shop that deserves a 5 star review. Keep up the great food!

Very disappointed in this restaurant - the food is a hit or miss. But most recently, I ordered through postmates for delivery. 
I ordered pad Thai $12.45 and small fried rice $3.50. That's no more than $17 rounded up. Well after my order was delivered, it became 24.48. That does not even include the service fee or delivery. How is it almost $10 more than what's listed on the menu?? I've never had a discrepancy like this from postmates when ordering. If you want to charge higher, than have it reflect it on the delivery partners site.
James is awesome! My husband forgot his card and he kept it safe till we came back to get it. I really appreciate him doing the right thing instead of keeping it like some people might.

Great spot in East Passyunk if you're looking for an indulgent brunch and not counting calories. We came here soon after they opened last year and loved the atmosphere inside. We ordered the fried chicken and the burger. The fried chicken was crispy but moist on the inside. The burger was sloppy and delicious. I also love places that put pickled onions on their burgers. 

We recently returned with Covid-19 safety precautions put in place. They added outdoor seating with a parklet. Most of the tables have an umbrella or are situated under their awning. The tables on the parklet were divided with plants and flowers, which created a nice atmosphere. The staff was incredibly attentive and friendly. We ordered the duck BLT and the pecan crusted wild caught catfish. The bacon on the BLT was crispy and the duck melted in your mouth. The honey-butter and crushed pecans on top of the catfish was an excellent touch. 

Overall, awesome spot. Can't wait to come back and hope they make it through this difficult time for restaurants, they deserve it.

Wasn't a busy Sunday, and the service was slow. Our waitress was adorable and super kind, but didn't pay much attention to the table. My eggs Benedict was awful. The eggs were cooked to the center, and not runny- how eggs Benedict is supposed to be. Onions are almost raw when they were asked to be put in the homefries. They pay very good attention and service their regular quickly. Hard to watch when you need a knife or a refill on a drink and they're treating their regulars like Kings/queens. I probably won't go back unfortunately.
The food and the shakes were really good. We got in way faster than they quoted us. Our server Caroline was amazing.

We first heard about Maiale after watching it on Diners, Drive-ins, and Dives. My husband, who's from the area, kept telling me it was something we had to try and that their food is incredible. We stopped by one day while visiting family and I was not disappointed. Their food are incredible and their service is great! My personal favorite would have to be the brats sandwich with an order of the french fries. You won't regret it!

We love visiting for lunch and enjoying the leftovers the next day.  Each time in we have tried something new and each time have been so happy with what we've gotten. I'm super fussy (much to my husbands chagrin) and would never turn down lunch or dinner here.
Love this place. Great selection of local, organic produce, dry goods, spices, cheese, etc. Also household items like cleaning and personal care supplies.
So so good! We were lucky to stumble across this little gem and I am glad we did. Food is authentic Italian and the service was wonderful. Definitely a must if you are in the area!

I placed a take out order of chicken Caesar salad but it was incomplete.  The next day I went back to the restaurant to explain what happened to the manager ( I neglected to catch her name) and she told me that soup was to always go with the order.  I placed an order for two. Chicken Cesar to take home and she only charged me for one plus added the soup and Spimoni ice cream.  Thank you.

This restaurant used to be pretty good (mostly back when it was Silvergreens), but it's a disaster now. They have a board with seasonal specials, but never have the actual ingredients to make them, and don't bother telling you until after you order and they hand your order to you. For the third time now, I've ordered the buffalo fries and they gave us our order and said they're out of buffalo sauce. It's literally 1:30pm -- this has also happened less than a half hour after they've opened -- so it's not like it's the end of the day. And then they say they're not making anymore, sorry. How hard is it to tell a customer that when they order so they can not order the item if it isn't as advertised? It's not that hard. Or better yet, how about don't offer a seasonal item if you can't actually make it? On top of that, their homemade veggie burger is gross and super carb-heavy (do not order it if you're a type 1 diabetic!). I'd rather have an Impossible Burger from the many nearby places instead. I give up on this place.

I would definitely recommend this to anyone who loves southern food. Their tenders are the best ones I've had. The selection of different heat levels are very unique in their on way. It's a smaller establishment but definitely a must try.

It looks okay when you first walk in.. but I was ignored for almost 15 minutes.. then when someone finally came up front to take my order, he told me to wait while he answered the phone to take their to go!?? I asked how long it would take to be ready and he shrugged his arms and told me he didn't know with a laugh ‍ I have currently been sitting here for an hour... I will never come back. TERRIBLE service
Great place for breakfast anytime of the day.  Join the waitlist if you're planning to come here.
amazing baked gnocchi. Baked lasagna is a must try!! My daughter and I come here once a month and enjoy every meal!
Great food, favorite local spot. Love Tempeh Plato, always great!  Service always good.  Thank you guys !

Peg Leg Porker was a recommendation to dine at while in Nashville. This place can get packed for dinner so I was excited. Our party had the opportunity to try one of the "best" BBQ places. We were very surprised once the food arrived and we tried the food. 

Meats:
* Pulled Pork Nachos - Tasty. Worth the order and shareable. 
* Pulled Pork - Better off getting the BBQ Nachos.
* Ribs - Dry and lacking. Maybe I'm not a dry rub kind of person, but I just don't see what the rave was all about. 

The sides were pretty plain Jane.

Fantastic Authentic Indian food. If you're looking for all the flavors, this is the place for you! We had samosas with their chutney (5 stars to the green mint chutney alone), tandoori chicken, vegetable tiki masala (holy shit, sooooooo good ) and chana palak. Together these amazing vegetables and flavors with their freshly made naan made our Covid dining experience amazing! Seriously though, you MUST try the naan. It was hot out of the pan. Actually everything was amazingly hot and delicious. Highly recommend. Stop in and enjoy.

Love this pizza and the staff is also so friendly and professional! Perfect Friday night pizza place with the kids, or leave the kids and drink beer upstairs with some free Mario Kart on the big screen! 

We recently asked for a donation for our nonprofit and they were happy to help. Seriously, this is the kind of locally owned, locally run pizza place you want your kids to grow up and work at one day! We love having them in the neighborhood!

This place was amazing! The black bean burger was very well seasoned. My daughter had the bistro burger cooked to perfection. My other daughter had the plain Jane pizza. We had the complimentary tomato soup shooter. We are definitely coming back. Service was excellent.  Natalie was so welcoming.
What a suprise. A top notch Mexican restaurant hidden in Port Richmond. Their homemade tortillas are from another planet. The tres leches was perfectly prepared. An amazing experience

Found this place with the help of Yelp after moving to a new area. Was desperate for a bagel with lox on a Sunday morning. Parking was easy. I do STRONGLY recommend getting there early. There was a bit of a wait and we beat the rush. We went at about 10 am and snagged the last of the lox for the day. We overheard quite a few "sorry we're all out for the day". All of the bagels were delicious. They have a large variety of bagels and spreads. They have coffee available as well in a serve yourself manner which a couple of varieties. There is also a cooler with drinks available. We waited about 20 minutes for our food. We ordered 4 bagels and a breakfast sandwich. The gentleman helping us did recommend calling ahead for orders so they are ready when you get there. A little pricey, but definitely worth it!

Had a fantastic meal at Filomenas, would highly recommend to anyone in the mood for Italian food. We came in 10 minutes before closing and were welcomed in. Ken was very friendly and has a wealth of experience working in the restaurant industry. Our food was prepared quickly and hit the spot. The meatballs and chicken parm were delicious and cooked to perfection. This is definitely our new favorite Italian place!
Absolutely great dining experience ! Food and service was amazing , ambiance is really nice too! Great outdoor/indoor open concept . Must come and have Chris serve you .

Great place!
Sat at the bar, Brookie, you were great!  The service was perfect.  Super attentive, decent size bar and she was making sure that everyone was well taken care of.  If your drink was even close to getting empty she was asking if you needed another, that was service.
They are located around the corner from the craziness of Broadway where you cannot hear yourself think, much less get service like this.
If you want to be in on the action, but not the craziness, you should visit them.
We didn't eat, but the food coming out of the kitchen did look very good.
Thanks again for the great service.

I eat here frequently and have never been disappointed.  The staff is friendly and professional and the food is always top notch.  They have a great wine selection and offer by the glass or bottle.  Try out their happy hour or Sunday brunch menus.  They have seating both inside and outside so when the whether is nice you have a great choice of seating.  Check out the upstairs dining and bar area.  Friday's can be busy so plan ahead and make a reservation.   You can always sit in the bar area and have a cocktail while you wait for your table.   Parking lot is shared with another restaurant so parking can be a challenge, but they do have valet service.

AWFUL.Ordered Shrimp fried rice.ONE shrimp in dirty old fried rice. The last time I had Shrimp Fried Rice from here..It was white rice tossed with fresh shrimp and green onion. I also ordered Bock Choi..It was NOT Bock Choi it was LETTUCE. The menu is confusing. Most employees speak/understand very little English and say YES to everything and then do not deliver. Waste of time & money. They seem nice...but it was not what I ordered.

Had a phenomenal time here! Our server Carly was very attentive and gave us great recommendations and had a really uplifting attitude! The wine flight was a good way to try some of their wines, I ended up buying two bottles of their winter spice which was great! Pricing was very reasonable and the decor of the restaurant was stunning! I plan on coming back!

Super nice person (owner?) serving who made us feel at home.  Would love if their website or other places showed more clearly (if it's there, I missed it) that this is a BYOB place.  After a long day would have loved a glass of wine or beer...nah.  Food fresh, ingredients fresh...tasty, looked nice.  A bit pricey overall but nicely done.  I am from out of town so may never get that way again...but if I did I'd bring a little wine and go again.
Place was a great and very enjoyable.place is beautiful and fun.Food was so good .Parnents  are world traveler and they highly impressed with this restaurant....
If you like your food dripping with a heavy red oil, this is the place for you. Greasy, greasy, greasy.

I've been to Culinary Dropout just once before the COVID-19 hit and I remember loving it. Spacious venue, a beautiful bar, live music, game area, PLUS great food and excellent service! So now that I'm back in town and places are open, I dragged my fiancé with me for a lunch date.

We were greeted and seated promptly. The staff was friendly and knowledgeable. I noticed right away that the menu was condensed for the epidemic. We started off with the Pork Belly Nachos appetizer and it was as good as we remembered it from last time! For our main, I had the Roasted Salmon with summer corn and my fiancé had the Pub Burger. He loved his dish and my salmon was cooked perfectly although the dish was a tiny bit too sweet for my liking. Regardless, it was an amazing dinner! The prices were fair and the service was excellent. Thank you to the staff and owners for being open, we'll be back again!

So good! My boyfriend and I love this place for thai food! I absolutely love the pad thai and the vegetarian dumplings. Also had the salmon teriyaki and it was amazing. This restaurant is high quality and will give you really good food (even when getting takeout they serve your plate looking gorgeous with carrot flowers). My boyfriend usually gets the tropical cashew (chicken and shrimp with pineapple/mango). He said it's amazing but he always has one complaint: not enough chicken/meat. Keep in mind they do not mess around with the spices!!

I love Greek food! My last name is Greek. The story goes that a couple brothers came over from Greece a long time ago and settled in South Carolina. There is even a town there named after me. Cool, right?

Maybe one of these days I will get to visit there. O yeah, I almost forgot, I am writing a review. I guess I had better get to that. Greek food ranks right up there with good BBQ for me. hmm, BBQ Gyros anyone?

My wife had the salad and chicken Kbobs. She said they were both excellent.

This is the 2nd time I have been to Taziki's. This time, I had the LAMB & SKORDALIA GYRO". I have had Gyros (Pronounced (YeeRoh) where the lamb is as tough as shoe leather. Not so here. The lamb is tender and juicy and done the way meat should be. Not Bloody.

I could smell the garlic when the server brought it out. Bellissimo!!!

It comes with roasted Red Peppers, grilled onions and a garlic sauce. The addition of Peppers and onions is not something I have ever had on a Gyro before. Love it!

The flavor is reminiscent to a Fajita, but this was way better than any Fajita I have ever had before in any Mexican restaurant anywhere. If you like Gyros, you need to come here and try this one. If you like Fajitas, you should come here and try this Gyro. This was my version of heaven. 

Now, for the opportunities for improvement. 

#1 The Gyro comes with chips. Not good chips either. Just ordinary Lays and not even flavored ones. It would be great if they offered choices of the kinds and flavors for

I love Italian food and have been to Italian. and this place is by far the most amazing Italian restaurant in St. Louis. It's a must go to place for the most amazing flavor/ warm fresh food and great staff! Their wine selection is perfect and this time tried the Italian marg and i must say it's one of the best margs I've had! Not only is the pasta so tasteful but the portion is out of this word. I cannot wait to go back!

I went with a friend here for lunch. Even during the busy lunchtime, the staff is very friendly and quick to take your order. The food is great. If you never tried Thai tea, let me tell you it is very good. The atmosphere is very beautiful and relaxed. For the price of the food, you get plenty of it. You will need to ask for a take home box for some of it.
Very good idea to place an empanadas right next to draught beer. I think that the best I ever tried. This location is must be visited if you are hanging out on the State street.

I don't normally go 5 stars because I feel there is always a little improvement that can be made, but this place was GREAT! I got quick service, they had drink specials going on while I was there. The food was incredible. I had the crab cakes to start off. Then had the redfish special with shrimp and crawfish tails over a bed of rice with a butter lemon sauce. Everything had great flavor and far exceeded my expectations. Will be back!

I can't start to explain how much of a surprise find this is! I would expect this in some sunny foreign country with white sand beaches. Tucson. Yep. Tucson. Anyone live anywhere near here get here and give it a try. It's not a typical style of food but it comes off like time tested recipes from tropical islands. Delicious. Friendly, welcoming staff. Great atmosphere. Can't beat it. Amazing. Our server was fantastic.
Try them you won't be let down! Portions are HUGE, options are endless, and the prices are reasonable. Make sure you order the Rasta pasta.

Zha Jiang Mien.  I always order two so I can have a bowl for breakfast the next day, but it rarely survives that brief, invariable 3 a.m. wake up, so I should probably order three.  I get angry with myself when it isn't there for when I intended.

Mulan has a fairly limited menu by most Chinese restaurant standards, but everything they offer is very well executed, from the basics to the chef's specials.  It's so hard to find a consistently good spot in this area, and I have tried many, multiple times.  

For take out Chinese in the area, this is the single, can't miss place.

Absolutely delicious!! So happy to have a Vegan joint within 10 minutes from my house. I ordered a basic burger with a few additions as well as the fried brussels sprouts which were beyond delicious.I will be back sooner than later

I was in Nashville for 4 days and I ate here twice. Absolutely no regrets. The best food and the kindest store owner. Highly recommend everything on the menu. The food coma afterwards was so worth it.

So. I ordered door dash and the order arrived 10 min earlier than expected.  Everything was cold on this hot sunny day. Is the food just sitting there waiting for people to order? The meatballs are $6.00. Look at these scrawny things. 2 lil measly balls. I ordered  the piggy fig and the cheesy garlic bread as well. The pizza was ok considering it was cold and the cheesy bread was just ok as well. probably will be my last time. People's incomes are not like they use to be. So when u wanna treat yourself to something nice you expect something nice.

If it was possible to give them a negative rating, I would totally do it.

The owner is so sweet in the beginning, "of course hunnay," but after she got the money, there comes issues here and there.

I had book this place for a wedding and made a deposit, after receiving the money, this is an up charge and we can't do this and that.  

I have heard many bad things about the owner and the restaurant afterwards. I should've asked around before making my decision.  However, in the end, it was too close to my wedding and she wanted to this and that extra. I ended cancelling and going to another restaurant. It was the best choice we've ever made!  

Avoid this place.

Our first visit, we did takeout and we're very happy with it! The ribs and the pulled pork were perfect, sides were delish and banana pudding excellent! 
We will definitely be back to dine at the Pig, great outdoor seating and very friendly service. From the call in, to delivery of the order, the service was top notch. Looking forward to try other menus items.
Supporting all heath guidelines.
Food was great! I got the breakfast burrito with potatoes, the potatoes where seasoned to perfection! Y husband had the salmon bagel and it was amazing!

We were lucky enough to try the Flatiron restaurant for Devour Indy 2020! The food was amazing!!! My friend had the salmon with risotta. I had the pot roast and the razor pork mac & cheese. All were to die for! So delicious and presented beautifully. Desserts were awesome, too! Our server Dani was friendly and helpful. We will definitely be back. We were told to come for the pancakes at brunch, so our next adventure here awaits!

Excellent spot located in the plaza mariachi mall. Very nice place to dine and very friendly staff. Menu was in English and they will explain about each item. Noticed that the food was not spicy at all however the flavors were absolutely to the point. Even surprised that the Onion and Tomato salad was fantastic. Yuca was fried to perfection and you get 2 sauces...the green one is spicy infact is ground chillies...the yellowbone seems to be mustard mayo. Whole chicken was also excellent. The plantain fry can be considered as a desert and the burnt ends tasted all the more better.

The location is cute but not a fan of the flavor. Got then bento box but it was definitely not worth the price. Lacked flavor and seasoning. My boyfriend got the Korean chicken tacos which were really good. Just be careful with what you order. Hit or miss.

Are you kidding me?  We called for a take out on Sunday evening and were rudely told that "we're too busy for take out."  Seriously, at a time of Covid with less tables (if you are following the mandate), you should have plenty of time for take outs!  We should have been told that it would be an hour of so but, nooo just rudely told they could not accomade us.
Really bad business practice.

I am in love with this place. Every single barista is friendly, competent, and quirky which fits the vibe of this particular area. I will admit though, after having watched a few of them work, some of them will short you on your shots of espresso.
The baby back ribs meal cost $25 now because of the bigger, more meat ribs. There are a lot more meat but they are dry and tasteless. So disappointed.

Alright so I finally came here. I told them it was my bday and they personalized the menu and gave me a candle. We decided on the chef tasting for $66/pp which comes with the main dish of lamb shoulder. The food was beautifully presented. I love the atmosphere and the appetizer courses were my favorite- the 6 small salad type items they provide you and the hummus. Another favorite dish of mine was the potato latke with fresh salmon, it transported me to feeling like I was on vacation. I don't know how else to explain it! One dessert we received wasn't sweet at all and another dessert was a custard. These flavors and food ingredients were new to me and I really enjoyed it!
The best food ever. Felt like family and I would eat here 100 times!! Everything was delicious!

Nice place!! Heard great things been there twice so far. Both times for lunch not too many people, the waitress is also the bartender and hostess and food runner and the only person I've seen working. Again I only been for lunch so maybe this is normal not sure. She maintains a smile and good customer service so that's great. The food is pretty good. I would love to go when there is entertainment at night so I can see how things really roll. But all in all a nice gem in claymont.

Came here to catch up with a friend or my birthday since it was one of few places that did indoor seating during the pandemic.  This is the 1st time I've been to the Campbell location. There was outside seating as well as indoor.  All the tables were more than 6 feet away from each other and all ther servers and staff had masks on.  We ordered 2 of the Benedict specials that they are popular for and  both were good.  Service was great and would definitely come back.  Prices are somewhat on the expense side fore breakfast foods but tasty.  It's somewhere you should try just for something unique and different flavors.
Stupid broad forgot to put in our appetizers and our food order! We waited for 2 hours! We left! Her name was MARIA!! Pathetic!!! Pay attention

Came by tonight for dinner and to watch a game.  Forgot to take pictures of our food till we were almost done, that being said, there was very little left to take a picture of. Haha

Atmosphere: somewhat loud, but great for watching a game.  Any game!  There are TVs in every direction so literally any game you want is on! 

We got the nachos, wings, and tortilla soup.  
Food was excellent.  Nacho cheese was a little spicy, but overall very tasty.  Wings: we got original amazing and dry rubbed garlic parm.  Original sauce was sweet and spicy at a very tolerable level.  Very good.  Dry rub was tasty but left the chicken very dry.  Still good, but probably won't do that one next time.  Soup was awesome.  Got that with a side of sour cream.  It was a perfect fall soup and satisfying!!! Would totally get that again! 

Service: was great!  Waitress was very attentive.  Drinks were full before the glass was empty and I appreciate that.  

Cost: totally reasonable! 

Only downfalls: 
So loud I had a headache when we left, not from alcohol, haha, but again, you expect noise at a sports bar, so be prepared for that. 

Dry rub chicken was super dry. 

Plus side: 
Good bar food
Great service
Every game is on.
This is my favorite Thai restaurant, easily. Best most flavorful green curry I've had, wonderfully seasoned and spicy drunken noodles, & crispy tofu. Staff is always kind both for dine in and to go.
Essentially they have overpriced artisan pizzas which almost always look completely different from what you're going to expect.  The pizzas are tasty but nothing to write home about.

This restaurant has become a go-to favorite. The Pad Thai and Orange Chicken surpassed my expectations. The crab rangoon is the best I've ever had. Actually everything I've had here is the best. Chinese is out the window after eating here. It's always fresh and the service is wonderful. You will not be disappointed.

This review is only for their lunch buffet. I hope to be back for their full dinner menu, because lunch was delicious. 

I arrived around 12:00 on a Sunday and the restaurant was packed! That's always a good sign. I wanted food to go and the kind waiter quickly brought me a to-go box, ordered some fresh Naan for me and sent me to the buffet. I LOADED it down. :) 

We tried the fruit salad, the mint, coconut and spicy chutneys, Tandoori chicken, basmati rice, vegggie samosas, lamb stew, and this sweet fried ball of dough (name?). I had "Hungry" (4 yrs old) and "Hurricane" (1 yr old) with me and they devoured everything. We loved putting the different chutneys on different foods. Of course, our most favorite thing was the fresh, steamy, garlic-y naan bread. I love carbs of any variety, but fresh naan bread is up there with holiness. 

The buffet cost around $11 and was definitely worth it. I shared with 2 other (small) people. I can only imagine how much more I would eat if I dined in.

Phenomenal customer service. The manager is hard working and very polite. Definitely deserves his position with how he greats every customer. Every staff employee was absolutely wonderful. Amazing place with great food and even better staff !
Disappointed!!!!!! Over priced and they dont serve liquor. I was shocked. Who eat tacos and dont drink a margarita?

They never get it right..there is always some kinda issue.and don't ever expect to get ur sauce with nuggets cuz no matter how many times u ask you won't get it,they tell u it's in the bag...and nothing....ever....it's happened the last 7 times.and we only ear out once a month or so..so that's 7 months to fix it with no results.

I always want to love DiFabios but this is the second order and the second disappointment. First of all, the take-out staff are miserable. The food choices are excellent but we paid $3 extra for broccoli rabe and it was all stems and undercooked. The truffle fries had a good flavor but the fries were undercooked. I also got the eggplant sandwich. Again, flavors were good but the onions were not caramelized and the food was cold. Maybe the experience is better when you dine in.

Came into town for a convention and was looking for a unique breakfast place. And this is it, the avocado toast is on Rye which is awesome and it's tastes amazing but then they go and add hummus to it and then to top it all off... pistachios!!! Absolutely genius. Next day I came back and tried the Twerk it addition of eggs and bacon and did not disappoint. I'm a good eater and this avocado toast was definitely substantial, I was absolutely stuffed with this fully loaded piled high toast. Not to mention the Veggie Burrito, my goodness extremely satisfying I ended up eating half and saving half for later great mix of veggies for the taste buds and satiety!

It's been a few months since I ordered Whataburger. Wish I hadn't waited so long! The onion rings were PERFECT! The chicken fajita taco. What can I say? It was delicious. This time I ordered the unsweetened iced tea. It was great. Icy cold. The way I love it. The only downside is that it's not on doordash, but, I found they deliver thru their app and doordash picks up. The fee was a bit high, but, the good food was well worth it

Such a good place to eat! I don't really know what to say except don't come here to eat health food and don't expect to go swimming for awhile after. The food is great and if you have a birthday it is worth stopping by just to see what happens. The chocolate chip pancakes are so good but the omelettes are great as well.

This was hands down one of the best coffee shops I've ever been to. Their drinks are super unique and incredible. I recommend ordering online and just going to the pick up window when you get there. Super quick and easy!
With good intentions of supporting a local restaurant, the delivery driver never showed up.

This place was hugely busy even late into the evening.  My burger was good but the bun was sweet and that sort or threw me off.  The wait to get  a table was long and we ended up at the adjacent bar with little elbow room.  Would  I recommend it... not for a first in town experience and would ask if they mind a sweet bun on a savory burger.
